clips.title: The story
paras: Along Auberdine’s shore, Gubber Blump fishes, teaches angling, and looks for fresh crab meat.

Gubber Blump fishes on the Darkshore coast, between Auberdine’s flight master and ferry pier. While most dwarves favor stone halls or forges, he chooses the shore. He teaches fishing and sells simple angling gear to travelers. Crab meat is among his favorite foods, and he often relies on travelers to bring in catches from the dangerous coast or recover his family fishing tackle.

Gubber Blump speaks freely about his family, especially his cousin Graun Blump, who has a beard and an unusual odor. Travelers who help with coastal work, such as gathering crawler legs or finding his family pole, may receive a handwritten thank-you letter and a shiny fishing lure for their next cast.
